target_claims.statement: A union-closed family containing {a} has a in at least half of its members.
A union-closed family containing {a,b} has at least one of a or b in at least half of its members.
Exact independent replay finds no nontrivial violation on universes n <= 4.

inputs: Pinned MATHCERT Lean sources for the restricted theorems.
Exact bounded certificate and independent replay implementation for n <= 4.
checker_contract.acceptance: The exact restricted claims build without placeholders and the bounded certificate replays with its finite range unchanged.
checker_contract.rejection: Reject semantic drift, missing hypotheses, failed replay, or promotion to the universal Frankl conjecture.

claim_boundary: Restricted Lean theorems and finite replay through n <= 4 do not prove Frankl's conjecture.
reopening_conditions: Reopen if a source identity, theorem statement, finite range, checker, or MATHCERT disposition changes.
